target: A certified 43-vertex graph with no monochromatic K5
family: All graphs obtained by deleting one vertex from an undirected Cayley graph on any group of order 44
group_cover: C11 semidirect C4 with inversion action
C11 semidirect V4 with nontrivial inversion action
reduction: A good puncture forces the full Cayley graph to be good: translate any monochromatic five-set away from the deleted vertex.
decision_variables: One Boolean variable per inverse orbit of nonidentity group elements
success: A SAT model, exported as a 43-vertex edge list and independently checked on every five-set, or checked UNSAT proofs for all four groups
failure: Any bounded UNKNOWN or failed formula/proof audit; preserve the exact boundary without a retry or adjacent group-order ladder
solver_policy: Kissat 4.0.4, at most 300 wall seconds per group, sequential, stop on SAT/UNKNOWN/check failure; binary DRAT checked by drat-trim -i for UNSAT
excluded_routes: No q10 relaunch, cyclic43 repair, C5[C5] refinement, symplectic restart, or h3887 re-encoding
